title: Scalar-unit normalized squares preserve horizontal adjunctions
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal C',\mathcal D'$ be categories. Specify adjunctions $P:\mathcal C\rightleftarrows\mathcal D:Q$ and $P':\mathcal C'\rightleftarrows\mathcal D':Q'$ with units $\eta,\eta'$ and counits $\epsilon,\epsilon'$. Let $F_C:\mathcal C\rightleftarrows\mathcal C':r_C$ and $F_D:\mathcal D\rightleftarrows\mathcal D':r_D$ be adjunctions with units $j_C,j_D$. Let $\mathcal C_0\subseteq\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D_0\subseteq\mathcal D$ be full subcategories such that $P(\mathcal C_0)\subseteq\mathcal D_0$ and $Q(\mathcal D_0)\subseteq\mathcal C_0$. Specify ambient natural isomorphisms
$$b:r_DP'\xrightarrow{\sim}Pr_C,\qquad d:r_CQ'\xrightarrow{\sim}Qr_D,$$
and a natural isomorphism $\alpha:F_DP|_{\mathcal C_0}\cong P'F_C|_{\mathcal C_0}$ and natural transformation $\beta:F_CQ|_{\mathcal D_0}\to Q'F_D|_{\mathcal D_0}$. Suppose that
$$r_D(\alpha_N)j_{D,PN}=b_{F_CN}^{-1}P(j_{C,N})\quad(N\in\mathcal C_0),$$
$$r_C(\beta_M)j_{C,QM}=d_{F_DM}^{-1}Q(j_{D,M})\quad(M\in\mathcal D_0),$$
$$r_D(\epsilon'_Z)b_{Q'Z}^{-1}=\epsilon_{r_DZ}P(d_Z)\quad(Z\in\mathcal D').$$
Then for every $M\in\mathcal D_0$ both maps $F_D(PQM)\to F_DM$ in the counit comparison have the same $F_D\dashv r_D$ transpose, namely
$$r_D\bigl(\epsilon'_{F_DM}P'(\beta_M)\alpha_{QM}\bigr)j_{D,PQM}=j_{D,M}\epsilon_M=r_D\bigl(F_D(\epsilon_M)\bigr)j_{D,PQM}.$$
Consequently
$$F_D(\epsilon_M)=\epsilon'_{F_DM}P'(\beta_M)\alpha_{QM}.$$
For every $N\in\mathcal C_0$, the $P'\dashv Q'$ transpose of $Q'(\alpha_N)\beta_{PN}F_C(\eta_N)$ is $1_{P'F_CN}$; hence
$$Q'(\alpha_N)\beta_{PN}F_C(\eta_N)=\eta'_{F_CN}.$$
Equivalently $\beta$ is the mate of $\alpha^{-1}$ for the restricted horizontal adjunctions, in the convention of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. No faithfulness of $F_D$, $r_D$, or the inclusion of realizable objects in $\mathcal D'$ is assumed. Composition is right to left.

proof.text: For each specified adjunction $L\dashv R$, use the Hom bijection $\Phi_{X,Y}(f)=R(f)\eta_X$ and its inverse $\Phi^{-1}_{X,Y}(g)=\epsilon_Y L(g)$ from [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Thus equality of these transposes implies equality of arrows. The containment assumptions on $P,Q$ allow restriction to the two full subcategories: the same Hom sets, units and counits give the restricted adjunction.

proof.text:
Fix $M\in\mathcal D_0$; then $QM\in\mathcal C_0$, so the first normalization applies at $QM$. Put $Z=F_DM$ and $c_M=\epsilon'_Z P'(\beta_M)\alpha_{QM}$. Its vertical transpose is, by that normalization and naturality of $b$ at $\beta_M:F_CQM\to Q'Z$,
$$\begin{aligned}r_D(c_M)j_{D,PQM}&=r_D(\epsilon'_Z)r_D(P'\beta_M)b_{F_CQM}^{-1}P(j_{C,QM})\\&=r_D(\epsilon'_Z)b_{Q'Z}^{-1}P(r_C\beta_M)P(j_{C,QM}).\end{aligned}$$

proof.text:
Apply the third hypothesis at the ambient object $Z=F_DM$, and then the second at $M$. The last expression becomes
$$\epsilon_{r_DZ}P(d_Z)P(r_C\beta_M)P(j_{C,QM})=\epsilon_{r_DZ}P(Q(j_{D,M}))=j_{D,M}\epsilon_M.$$
The last equality is naturality of $\epsilon$ at $j_{D,M}:M\to r_DF_DM$. Naturality of $j_D$ at $\epsilon_M$ also gives $r_D(F_D\epsilon_M)j_{D,PQM}=j_{D,M}\epsilon_M$. These are exactly the asserted two transpose formulas; no membership of $r_DF_DM$ in $\mathcal D_0$ was used.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint and the following paragraph (equivalent adjunct formulas); explicit normalized-square calculation by N9

proof.text:
Injectivity of the $F_D\dashv r_D$ Hom bijection in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] now gives $c_M=F_D(\epsilon_M)$. Since $\alpha_{QM}$ is invertible, equivalently
$$\epsilon'_{F_DM}P'(\beta_M)=F_D(\epsilon_M)\alpha_{QM}^{-1}.$$

proof.text: First identify the mate, using step 4: let a be the restriction of the unprimed adjunction to the full subcategories. Mathlib's map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app identifies its counit after inclusion with the ambient counit. For each M, mateEquiv_counit says that the primed inverse transpose of the mate of alpha inverse is alpha inverse at QM followed by F_D(epsilon_M). Substitute step 4 and cancel alpha inverse followed by alpha. Injectivity of the primed inverse Hom bijection identifies each component with beta_M; natural-transformation extensionality gives the mate identity.

proof.text: For N in C_0, map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app identifies the restricted unit after inclusion with eta_N. The unit_mateEquiv identity, substituting the mate equality just proved, gives F_C(eta_N) followed by beta_PN equal to eta' at F_CN followed by Q'(alpha inverse at N). Postcompose with Q'(alpha at N), use functoriality and cancel alpha inverse followed by alpha. This proves the asserted unit equality. Its primed inverse transpose is the identity by the left triangle identity (equivalently the inverse Hom bijection sends the unit to the identity).
